title: VESPER WorldFact
description: The unit of the persistent world model. COC ARCH-05 states 'use timestamps and confidence so stale observations do not become current truth' -- sound only if clocks agree, which across a roaming laptop, a legacy handset and a sleeping desktop they do not. This contract makes freshness decidable. Authority: DR-003, DR-011, RB-002, RB-003, ARCH-05, ARCH-22; REM-001, REM-011.

subject.description: Stable entity id. Evidence -> identity resolution is an explicit policy (DF-IDENTITY-RESOLVE), never an implicit join.

state.description: SM-WORLD-FACT. UNKNOWN is a FIRST-CLASS VALUE, not an absence and never a degradation to 'last known value' (INV-COORD-2). A reader receiving UNKNOWN has received an answer, and the correct downstream behaviour is to retrieve, observe, ask or report uncertainty -- which is RB-002 executed rather than asserted.

value.description: MUST be absent when state is UNKNOWN. Typed per attribute.

observed_at_wall.description: Display and policy windows only. INV-COORD-4.

valid_until.description: Absolute, derived from the observation type's declared TTL. Every observation type MUST declare one; a type with no TTL cannot be registered.

source.description: INV-AUTO-4: the world model is writable by observation sources EXTERNAL to the decision loop. 'synthetic_observer' is an enrolled Z2 node using the same production ingress as a camera -- which is what makes A-029 part 3 a test of the product rather than of scaffolding.

supersedes.description: Previous fact_id, retained. Corrections preserve provenance (IC-006).

conflict_with.description: Set when state is CONFLICTED. INV-COORD-3: no conflict is resolved without an emitted world.conflict event, and the world model never selects a winner silently.

allOf.$comment: A CONFLICTED fact names its counterpart.
